spans.text: 添加必要的注释说明重构理由和关键改动
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes ensuring functional consistency after refactoring and adding comments explaining the rationale for changes, optimization strategies, and expected effects. It promotes transparency about what was changed and why, which supports information integrity.
